name: ROBAN
summary:
ROBAN is LEJU's humanoid education and development platform, with a dedicated section in the manufacturer's technical community. The community presents it in the context of higher-education AI learning and provides discussion of programming, simulation, perception and competition activities.

This series-level entry describes the platform's educational role. A specific ROBAN configuration and its accompanying documentation are needed to establish dimensions, available sensors and supported development tools; community examples should not be treated as guaranteed capabilities of every hardware
